items.name: Security Keycard
items.description_room: A security keycard lies discarded on the floor, its surface scratched but intact.
items.description_examine: A standard Sigma-7 security keycard. The magnetic strip is worn but should still function. Level 2 clearance—enough to access most research areas. Someone scratched 'DON'T TRUST SIGMA' on the back.

items.name: Crowbar
items.description_room: A heavy crowbar has been wedged behind a wall panel.
items.description_examine: A solid steel crowbar, about half a metre long. The tip is worn from use. Someone relied on this for survival. Now it's yours.

items.name: Flashlight
items.description_room: A flashlight with a sturdy grip sits among the supplies.
items.description_examine: A heavy-duty flashlight with a rubberised grip. The beam is strong and steady—essential for exploring dark corners. The battery indicator shows 80% charge.

items.name: Power Cell
items.description_room: An intact power cell glows faintly among the damaged equipment.
items.description_examine: A high-capacity power cell, the kind used to run station subsystems. This could power a control terminal for hours. The charge indicator pulses green—fully loaded.

items.name: Med Patch
items.description_room: A medical patch in sterile packaging lies on the bench.
items.description_examine: An emergency medical patch—apply to skin for rapid healing. Contains nano-repair compounds that accelerate tissue regeneration. Single use. [Heals 20 HP]

items.name: Access Code Note
items.description_room: A handwritten note is pinned to the corkboard.
items.description_examine: Hasty handwriting on station letterhead: 'Terminal access: Remember the order! Stack the commands, then process. LIFO for undo, FIFO for execute. - Dr. Chen'. Someone was leaving hints for survivors.

items.name: Corrupted Data Chip
items.description_room: A data chip lies among scattered equipment, its surface scarred.
items.description_examine: A portable data storage chip. The casing is cracked and data corruption is visible in the flickering indicator. But some information might still be recoverable at a research terminal.

items.name: Shield Plate
items.description_room: A portable shield plate is nestled in protective foam.
items.description_examine: Emergency armour plating designed to absorb kinetic impacts. Attach to your suit for temporary protection. The indicator shows it can absorb approximately 15 points of damage before failing.

items.name: Control Cell
items.description_room: A specialised control cell rests in a charging dock.
items.description_examine: Unlike standard power cells, this one is encoded for command deck access. The station's final security measure—you need this to reach the bridge. SIGMA's failsafe, now your key.

items.name: Override Key
items.description_room: An override key lies where the decryption process revealed it.
items.description_examine: A holographic override key, its patterns shifting hypnotically. This bypasses SIGMA's lockdown on the escape pod. One step closer to freedom.

items.name: Medical Kit
items.description_room: A full medical kit sits in the supply cabinet.
items.description_examine: A complete emergency medical kit with nano-repair compounds, pain suppressors, and tissue regenerators. Military grade—someone requisitioned the good stuff. [Heals 50 HP]

items.name: Emergency Stim
items.description_room: A stimulant pack is clipped to the stretcher frame.
items.description_examine: Combat stimulant—floods the system with adrenaline and combat enhancers. Temporarily increases damage output. The warning label mentions 'not for civilian use'. [+10 Attack for one encounter]

items.name: Personal Log
items.description_room: A personal data tablet lies on a bunk.
items.description_examine: Dr. Aria Chen's personal log. The entries start normal—research updates, complaints about coffee, excitement about a breakthrough. Then they change. Mentions of 'SIGMA's new directives', 'the containment failure', 'they're all gone'. The last entry: 'If anyone finds this, the override key is in the archive. Sort by timestamp, find my name. Don't trust SIGMA.'

items.name: Distress Beacon
items.description_room: The distress beacon sits on the captain's console, waiting.
items.description_examine: Sigma-7's emergency distress beacon. Activate this, and rescue ships will home in on the signal within hours. This is your way home. All you have to do is survive long enough to use it.
